name: Forget memory item
description: Remove memory item number n (as shown by memory_recall). Remaining items renumber to close the gap. The removal is durable (whole-list replace) and does not re-materialise.

n.description: 1-based item number to remove (as shown in the numbered list).

path.description: Workspace path of the memory list (default 'w/memory').

forgotten.description: True if the item was removed.
